notablePrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Insect.
Laid to Rest triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token.
The Insect enters the battlefield, triggering Blasting Station, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 4, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat from step 4.
